description: Maps each DB-stored scenario (by exact title) for the Patent Cliffs topic to the 5 curated deck scenarios shown in the Wiley Horizons brief. The DB scenarios are the canonical evidence base; this overlay provides the public-facing framing.

patent_cliffs_revenue_disruption.primary_signal: Patent cliffs will drive revenue declines and stock volatility for major firms like Merck and Sanofi, with generics and biosimilars rapidly eroding protected market share.
patent_cliffs_revenue_disruption.minority_view: Some believe robust pipelines or regulatory interventions could delay or soften the revenue impact for incumbents.

decision_fork.favorable: If companies replenish pipelines and execute M&A: revenue stabilization and sustained leadership for firms like Merck and Eli Lilly.
decision_fork.adverse: If generic entry accelerates and innovation lags: loss of market share, profit erosion, and further investor pressure for traditional pharma giants.

action_windows.0_6_months: Assess portfolio LOE exposure and pipeline readiness
action_windows.6_18_months: Initiate pipeline renewal or pursue targeted M&A

cost_pressure_access.primary_signal: High-priced therapies, especially GLP-1 drugs, are driving up system-wide costs and out-of-pocket expenses, with severe access challenges in emerging markets like India.
cost_pressure_access.minority_view: Value-based pricing or payer innovation may mitigate cost burdens before they become systemic risks.

decision_fork.favorable: If pricing reforms and payer adaptation occur: managed cost growth and improved patient access.
decision_fork.adverse: If status quo persists: worsening affordability, increased poverty, and intensified scrutiny of pharma pricing practices.

action_windows.0_6_months: Analyze payer relationships and exposure to high-cost therapies
action_windows.6_18_months: Develop access strategies or engage in policy dialogue

rd_model_transformation.primary_signal: AI-driven drug discovery and the rise of digital pharma hubs in locations like Hyderabad will accelerate pipeline renewal, biosimilar launches, and reshape global R&D networks.
rd_model_transformation.minority_view: Some foresee persistent organizational inertia or regulatory constraints slowing digital adoption.

decision_fork.favorable: If digital and AI adoption accelerates: firms like Biocon and Samsung Bioepis gain speed and cost advantages in new drug and biosimilar launches.
decision_fork.adverse: If legacy R&D models persist: innovation cycle stagnates, leaving incumbents vulnerable post-patent cliff.

action_windows.0_6_months: Evaluate digital maturity and talent hub strategy
action_windows.6_18_months: Invest in AI platforms and cross-border R&D collaborations

regionalization_market_access.primary_signal: Telangana and Hyderabad will emerge as global techbio anchors, enabling faster drug launches and diversified market access strategies through cross-border R&D, AI-powered networks, and adaptive pricing.
regionalization_market_access.minority_view: A minority maintains that legacy Western hubs will retain dominance due to regulatory, capital, or IP advantages.

decision_fork.favorable: If regional hubs and alliances are leveraged: executive organizations achieve faster launches and broader access via Asia-led innovation ecosystems.
decision_fork.adverse: If global collaboration lags: access bottlenecks persist, and traditional pharma geographies risk isolation.

action_windows.0_6_months: Map global hub participation and supply chain exposure
action_windows.6_18_months: Form cross-border partnerships and invest in hub infrastructure

therapy_area_evolution.primary_signal: Biologics, JAK inhibitors, and late-stage oncology assets will drive growth, requiring new go-to-market models and pipeline strategies.
therapy_area_evolution.minority_view: Some suggest that primary care and generics will continue to dominate due to emerging market demand and payer constraints.

decision_fork.favorable: If organizations prioritize specialty and biologics pipelines: accelerated growth in high-value therapy areas and increased differentiation.
decision_fork.adverse: If focus remains on legacy or primary care products: stagnant growth and increased vulnerability to generic erosion.

action_windows.0_6_months: Review portfolio concentration and specialty pipeline depth
action_windows.6_18_months: Pivot R&D and commercial strategy to specialty areas
